## Proposed change
<!--

  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.

This PR complements the Fan (fs) category with resources available in [Tuya's documentation](https://developer.tuya.com/en/docs/iot/f?id=K9gf45vs7vkge) that are not part of the fan entity.

<html>
<body>
<!--StartFragment-->

Code | Name | Data type | Value constraint
-- | -- | -- | --
fan_vertical | Vertical swing flap angle | Enum | {“range”:[“30”,“60”,“90”]}
fan_horizontal | Horizontal swing flap angle | Enum | {“range”:[“30”,“60”,“90”]}
anion | Anion | Boolean | {}
humidifier | Humidification | Boolean | {}
oxygen | Oxygen bar | Boolean | {}
fan_cool | Cool wind | Boolean | {}
fan_beep | Sound | Boolean | {}
child_lock | Child lock switch | Boolean | {}
light | Light switch | Boolean | {}
bright_value | Brightness value | Integer | {“min”:10,“max”:1000,“scale”:0,“step”:1}
temp_value | Temperature value | Integer | {“min”:0,“max”:1000,“scale”:0,“step”:1}
work_mode | Light mode | Enum | {“range”:[“white”,“colour”,“colourful”]}
temp | Temperature setting | Integer | {“unit”:“℃”,“min”:0,“max”:50,“scale”:0,“step”:1}
*countdown | Countdown | Enum | {“range”:[“0”,“1”,“2”,“3”,“4”,“5”,“6”]}
countdown_set | Countdown setting | Enum | {“range”:[“cancel”,“1h”,“2h”,“3h”,“4h”,“5h”,“6h”]}

<!--EndFragment-->
</body>
</html>

**Not tested with a device as there is no virtual Fan device available.**

issue_context.title: Tuya ceiling fan - does not support light
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I recently installed a ceiling fan and the light feature is missing from the tuya component.

![FanCapture1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5051561/150677280-cc56cc37-4f3b-46cd-ab3e-3dec39de5da0.PNG)

![FanCapture2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5051561/150677287-d54b4edd-e81c-46ff-a67e-600c21f8fddc.PNG)

![FanCapture3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5051561/150677407-be24ac19-5c23-47b1-b97e-e90a2498bef6.png)

I've added the following to light.py and I'm able to toggle the light on/off, however unable to control brightness / colour temp.

```
    # Fan
    # https://developer.tuya.com/en/docs/iot/categoryfs?id=Kaiuz1xweel1c
    "fs": (
        TuyaLightEntityDescription(
            key=DPCode.LIGHT,
            brightness=DPCode.BRIGHT_VALUE,
            color_temp=DPCode.TEMP_VALUE,
        ),
    ),
```

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.12.10

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Tuya

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/tuya/
